shared_elements: animal head with muzzle in profile
row of repeated small motifs along an edge
justification: Both are stone low reliefs organised into horizontal registers containing profile quadrupeds alongside a plant/foliage motif and a repeated small-motif border, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a narrow vertical pillar with schematic, blocky, largely undetailed forms stacked one above another, while B is a broad horizontal frieze with finely textured, anatomically observed animals and attendant standing figures, so the manner of execution and overall format differ sharply.
